title: Symbolic 3D Grounding and Software-Pipelined VLA Task Planning for Multi-Arm Manipulation
ledeHtml: When orchestrating multiple 7-DoF robotic manipulators in a shared physical workspace, streaming overhead RGB camera frames on every planning turn inflates token budgets and GPU rendering latency. In our three-arm Franka Emika FR3 station in NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 (240 Hz PhysX TGS) bridged over FastDDS unicast to ROS 2 Jazzy (50 Hz damped least-squares inverse kinematics), we demonstrate that symbolic 3D /tf coordinate grounding paired with a hybrid Brain-Executor routing topology discovers a conflict-free 10-turn software-pipelined schedule—cutting per-trial API cost by 76.6% ($0.01972 vs. $0.08437) with zero RGB image tokens.
hubTitle: Symbolic 3D /tf Grounding & 10-Turn Pipelined VLA: ER-2 vs. Gemini 4 Carbon
hubDesc: 0 RGB tokens, 10-turn pipelined schedule, and -76.6% API cost ($0.01972) in Isaac Sim 6.0.
bodyHtml:
TL;DR — Research Highlights & Systems Summary
  • Zero-RGB Symbolic 3D /tf Grounding: Disabling Isaac Sim Replicator RGB camera capture (latest_rgb = None, 0 image tokens) and feeding 50 Hz 3D /tf poses into RuleBasedTaskGenerator and RuleBasedTaskVerifier achieved 100% (9/9) multi-robot tower assembly with zero collisions across all three stages.
  • Hybrid Brain-Executor Routing (-76.6% API Cost): Invoking gemini-4-carbon once on Turn 0 (thinking_budget=256) to synthesize the global schedule and delegating Turns 1–10 to gemini-3.5-flash-lite (thinking_budget=0) reduced trial cost from $0.08437 to $0.01972 and lowered early-turn step latency from 13.31 s to 4.17 s (-68.7%).
  • Software-Pipelined Multi-Arm Interleaving (10 vs. 13 Turns): Whereas gemini-robotics-er-2-preview stalled at wave-locked barriers (13 turns, 50,190 tokens), gemini-4-carbon overlapped outer-table pick and go_home actions with central-tower place motions from Turn 3 onward, finishing in 10 turns and avoiding 10,929 quadratic history tokens.

Rethinking Visual Tokens in Closed-Loop Multi-Arm Manipulation

A common assumption in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) system design is that high-level task planners must continuously ingest multi-view RGB camera frames at every decision step. In multi-manipulator simulation and industrial workcells, however, streaming high-resolution base64 images on every turn introduces two compounding bottlenecks: it forces the physics simulator to run expensive GPU render-product pipelines (such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim Replicator viewports), and it appends thousands of visual tokens to a conversation history that grows quadratically with episode length.

In M9G's IsaacSim_GeminiRobotics testbed (Mode 1, three_robot_tower.py), three 7-DoF Franka Emika FR3 manipulators (FR3_1, FR3_2, FR3_3) surround a shared central stacking platform at [0.0, 0.0] while drawing from three outer source tables holding nine numbered blocks (B1..B9). Rather than passing overhead RGB frames (latest_rgb = None, --enable-cameras disabled), our closed-loop controller grounds the LLM strictly on 50 Hz 3D /tf transforms (WorkspaceState), a deterministic spatial blueprint synthesized by RuleBasedTaskGenerator, and a pre-execution kinematic and ownership shield (RuleBasedTaskVerifier) driving a 50 Hz damped least-squares (DLS) inverse kinematics controller over FastDDS unicast.

Decoupling Strategic Synthesis from Deterministic Step Execution

To isolate the impact of frontier reasoning versus step-execution latency, GeminiRoboticsNode._run_automated_comparison_workflow() executes a continuous three-stage hardware-in-the-loop protocol inside a single simulation process. Between stages, the node publishes Empty() to /reset_simulation, restoring all nine blocks to Tables 1–3 and homing FR3_1..3 across a 4.0-second mechanical settle window:

  • Stage 1 — Legacy Homogeneous VLA Loop (gemini-robotics-er-2-preview): Uses gemini-robotics-er-2-preview for both Turn-0 strategy generation (thinking_budget=256) and every subsequent tool-dispatch turn (thinking_budget=512).
  • Stage 2 — Pure Frontier Reasoning Loop (gemini-4-carbon): Runs gemini-4-carbon on Turn 0 (thinking_budget=256) and across all step turns (thinking_budget=512) to measure the scheduling gain of frontier reasoning and its raw step-latency cost.
  • Stage 3 — Hybrid Brain-Executor Routing (1x gemini-4-carbon + 10x gemini-3.5-flash-lite): Invokes gemini-4-carbon strictly once on Turn 0 (thinking_budget=256) to synthesize the 10-turn software-pipelined schedule, then delegates Turns 1–10 to gemini-3.5-flash-lite with thinking_budget=0, escalating back to Carbon only if a pick fault or RuleBasedTaskVerifier rejection occurs.

Empirical Telemetry Across the Three-Stage Evaluation

All three stages achieved 100% task completion (9/9 blocks stacked on the central tower) and a 100% pre-execution safety verifier pass rate, confirming that symbolic 3D /tf grounding suffices for collision-free multi-arm coordination. However, the three architectures differed sharply in schedule horizon, step latency, and API cost:

Figure 2A. API Cost per 9-Block Trial (M9G Telemetry) USD • Trace: CUSTOM_trial01_20261018

Quadratic Context Accumulation & Thinking-Budget Economics

Even with camera streams disabled, input tokens represent 96.4% to 97.8% of total token volume across all three stages. Each turn transmits a static base context of ~2,800 tokens—comprising SYSTEM_PROMPT and ROBOT_TOOLS JSON schemas (~1,450 tokens) plus the Turn-0 RuleBasedTaskGenerator 3D blueprint and strategy (~1,350 tokens)—alongside a rolling increment of 250 to 380 tokens of multi-turn function_call and controller function_response records. Re-sending the rolling conversation history on every turn yields quadratic input growth with respect to horizon T:

M9G Context Scaling Rule (IsaacSim_GeminiRobotics Mode 1) Ref: M9G-TR-2026-01
Cumulative Input Tokens (for T turns) = (T × 2,800 Base Context Tokens) + [ T × (T − 1) / 2 ] × (250 to 380 Per-Turn History Tokens)

Compressing the schedule from 13 turns (Stage 1) to 10 turns (Stages 2 and 3) eliminates the three largest context turns at the end of the episode (where each call exceeds 4,500 input tokens), saving 10,929 input tokens automatically. Furthermore, in Stage 1, gemini-robotics-er-2-preview consumed 1,086 internal thinking tokens billed at the $10.00/1M output rate ($0.01086, or 13.8% of Stage 1's entire cost), whereas in Stage 2, allowing thinking_budget=512 on routine step turns inflated mean step latency on Turns 1–2 to 13.31 seconds. By restricting reasoning to Turn 0 on gemini-4-carbon ($2.00/1M in, $10.00/1M out) and executing Turns 1–10 on gemini-3.5-flash-lite ($0.30/1M in, $2.50/1M out, thinking_budget=0), Stage 3 decomposes trial cost as follows:

M9G Stage 3 Hybrid Cost Breakdown (CUSTOM_trial01_20261018_174106.jsonl) Total: $0.01972 (-76.6%)
1. Turn 0 Global Brain (Gemini 4 Carbon, 1 Call): 2,800 input tokens (× $2.00 / 1M) + 220 output tokens (× $10.00 / 1M) = $0.00780
2. Turns 1 to 10 Step Executor (Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, 10 Calls): 34,648 input tokens (× $0.30 / 1M) + 609 output tokens (× $2.50 / 1M) = $0.01192
Total Stage 3 Episode Cost: $0.00780 + $0.01192 = $0.01972 (−76.6% vs. Stage 2 Pure Carbon)

Inside the 10-Turn Software-Pipelined Schedule

In the shared 3-arm station, the central stacking zone at [0.0, 0.0] is governed by a spatial mutex (center_occupied_by): only one manipulator may execute a central place motion on any given turn, whereas outer-table pick and go_home motions execute in kinematically disjoint zones. Inspecting the raw JSONL trace reveals how gemini-4-carbon exploits this spatial decoupling compared to gemini-robotics-er-2-preview:

M9G Multi-Manipulator Schedule Trace • 3x Franka Emika FR3 Source: CUSTOM_trial01_20261018_174106.jsonl

Because only one arm can occupy [0.0, 0.0] per turn, overlapping one central place with one outer-table pick or go_home on every turn after Turn 2 is the shortest conflict-free schedule for a 3-arm shared-center station. Moreover, on Turns 9 and 10, the Carbon schedule proactively overlaps go_home(FR3_1) and go_home(FR3_2) while Layers 8 and 9 are being placed, achieving complete workspace clearance in 20 verified tool calls (workload Gini coefficient 0.0339 across 7, 7, 6 actions).

Research Provenance, Prior Art Disclosure & Anti-Scraping Notice

This technical article (M9G-TR-2026-01), its three-stage evaluation protocol, software-pipelined multi-arm schedule, and empirical telemetry from CUSTOM_trial01_20261018_174106.jsonl constitute original published prior art by Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (장민수 / M9G). This work is published exclusively as a web-native technical research disclosure on mincasurong.github.io. Unauthorized copying, translation, or conversion of these tables, schedules, or analyses into third-party conference papers (IEEE ICRA, IROS, RA-L) or arXiv preprints is strictly prohibited.

ko.articleTitle: 다중 로봇 팔 매니퓰레이션을 위한 3D 심볼릭 그라운딩 및 소프트웨어 파이프라인 VLA 태스크 플래닝
ko.articleLede: 공유 작업 공간에서 다수의 7자유도(7-DoF) 로봇 팔을 동시에 제어할 때, 매 플래닝 턴마다 상단 RGB 카메라 이미지를 전송하면 토큰 비용과 GPU 렌더링 지연이 급증합니다. 본 연구는 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0(240 Hz PhysX TGS)과 ROS 2 Jazzy(50 Hz DLS 역기구학 제어기)를 FastDDS 유니캐스트로 연결한 3대 Franka Emika FR3 스테이션에서, 순수 3D /tf 좌표 그라운딩과 하이브리드 Brain-Executor 라우팅만으로 무충돌 10턴 소프트웨어 파이프라인 스케줄을 도출하여 API 비용을 76.6%($0.08437 → $0.01972) 절감함을 실증합니다.
ko.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR — 핵심 연구 결과 및 시스템 요약
ko.finding1: RGB 이미지 없는 3D /tf 심볼릭 그라운딩: Isaac Sim Replicator 카메라 캡처를 비활성화(latest_rgb = None, 이미지 토큰 0개)하고 50 Hz 3D /tf 좌표와 RuleBasedTaskVerifier 안전 검증기만으로 전 단계 9/9 블록 무충돌 조립(100% 성공)을 달성했습니다.
ko.finding2: 하이브리드 Brain-Executor 라우팅 (-76.6% API 비용): Turn 0에서 gemini-4-carbon(thinking_budget=256)을 단 1회 호출해 전역 스케줄을 수립하고, Turn 1~10 실행은 gemini-3.5-flash-lite(thinking_budget=0)에 위임하여 비용을 $0.01972로 낮추고 초기 스텝 지연을 13.31초에서 4.17초(-68.7%)로 단축했습니다.
ko.finding3: 소프트웨어 파이프라인 다중 로봇 인터리빙 (10턴 vs. 13턴): gemini-robotics-er-2-preview가 웨이브 배리어 대기(13턴, 50,190 토큰)에 머문 반면, gemini-4-carbon은 3턴부터 외곽 테이블 파지(pick)와 중앙 적재(place)를 중첩 실행하여 10턴 만에 완료하고 누적 히스토리 토큰 10,929개를 절약했습니다.

ja.articleTitle: マルチアーム操作における3DシンボリックグラウンディングとソフトウェアパイプラインVLAタスク計画
ja.articleLede: 共有作業空間内で複数の7自由度ロボットアームを協調制御する際、毎ターンRGBカメラ画像を送信するとトークン予算とGPU描画遅延が増大します。NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 (240 Hz PhysX TGS) と ROS 2 Jazzy (50 Hz DLS逆運動学制御) を接続した3台Franka Emika FR3ステーションにおいて、3D /tf座標グラウンディングとハイブリッドBrain-Executorルーティングにより10ターンのパイプラインスケジュールを導出し、APIコストを76.6% ($0.08437 → $0.01972) 削減できることを実証しました。
ja.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR — リサーチハイライト & システム要約
ja.finding1: 画像トークンゼロの3D /tfシンボリックグラウンディング: RGB描画を無効化し、50 Hzの3D /tf座標と事前安全検証器のみで全3ステージとも9/9ブロックを無衝突で組立完了。
ja.finding2: ハイブリッド Brain-Executor ルーティング (-76.6% APIコスト): Turn 0で gemini-4-carbon (thinking_budget=256) を1回呼び出し、Turn 1〜10を gemini-3.5-flash-lite (thinking_budget=0) に委譲することで、総コストを$0.01972、初期ステップ遅延を4.17秒 (-68.7%) に短縮。
ja.finding3: ソフトウェアパイプライン並列スケジュール (10 vs. 13ターン): ER-2の13ターン・バリア待機に対し、Carbonはターン3以降で外側テーブルのpickと中央のplaceを並列化し、10ターンで完了して10,929入力トークンを削減。

zh.articleTitle: 面向多机械臂操作的 3D 符号空间接地与软件流水线 VLA 任务规划
zh.articleLede: 在共享工作空间中协同控制多台 7 自由度机械臂时，若每轮规划均传输顶部 RGB 相机图像，将显著推高 Token 消耗与 GPU 渲染延迟。在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 (240 Hz PhysX TGS) 与 ROS 2 Jazzy (50 Hz 阻尼最小二乘逆运动学) 组成的 3 台 Franka Emika FR3 工站上，我们证明纯 3D /tf 坐标接地配合混合 Brain-Executor 路由可生成无冲突的 10 轮软件流水线调度，在零图像 Token 下将单次实验 API 成本从 $0.08437 降至 $0.01972 (-76.6%)。
zh.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR — 核心研究亮点与系统摘要
zh.finding1: 零 RGB 图像的 3D /tf 符号接地：禁用 Isaac Sim Replicator 相机渲染（latest_rgb = None，0 图像 Token），仅凭 50 Hz 3D /tf 坐标反馈与前置安全校验器即实现了 9/9 积木零碰撞装配（100% 通过）。
zh.finding2: 混合 Brain-Executor 路由 (-76.6% API 成本)：在 Turn 0 调用 1 次 gemini-4-carbon (thinking_budget=256) 生成全局 10 轮流水线策略，并将 Turn 1–10 交由 gemini-3.5-flash-lite (thinking_budget=0) 执行，将总成本降至 $0.01972，前两轮步进延迟从 13.31 秒降至 4.17 秒 (-68.7%)。
zh.finding3: 软件流水线多臂交错调度 (10 轮 vs. 13 轮)：gemini-robotics-er-2-preview 采用波次屏障批处理（13 轮），而 gemini-4-carbon 从第 3 轮起将外侧桌面抓取与中心放置交错并行，10 轮完成任务并节省 10,929 个二次方历史输入 Token。
zh.kpi2Note: 10 轮 vs. ER-2 13 轮 (-22.6% 输入 Token)

zh.ts1Sub: 两个规划器均读取 3D /tf 积木位姿，并在第 1 轮同时派发 3 台机械臂抓取 (B1, B4, B7)。
zh.ts2Title: 第 3 轮调度分叉：屏障等待 vs. 流水线交错
zh.ts2Sub: ER-2 串行放置导致等待，而 Carbon 在第 3 轮将外侧桌面的 pick(R1,B2) 与中央塔台的 place(R2) 并行重叠。
zh.ts3Title: ER-2 完成第 9 层装配 (13 轮)
zh.ts3Sub: 共耗时 13 轮 (50,190 Token, $0.07860)，且结束时机械臂未执行归位 (go_home)。
zh.ts4Title: Carbon 完成第 9 层装配并主动归位 (10 轮)
zh.ts4Sub: 在第 8–9 层放置期间并行重叠 go_home(R1, R2)，仅用 10 轮 (38,277 Token) 完成全部 9 块积木装配。

es.articleTitle: Anclaje Simbólico 3D y Planificación de Tareas VLA Segmentada para Manipulación Multi-Brazo
es.articleLede: Al coordinar múltiples manipuladores robóticos de 7-DoF en un espacio de trabajo compartido, transmitir imágenes RGB en cada turno infla el presupuesto de tokens y la latencia GPU. En nuestra estación de tres brazos Franka Emika FR3 en NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 (240 Hz PhysX TGS) y ROS 2 Jazzy (cinemática inversa DLS a 50 Hz), demostramos que el anclaje simbólico 3D /tf combinado con un enrutamiento híbrido Cerebro-Ejecutor descubre un cronograma segmentado de 10 turnos libre de conflictos, reduciendo el costo API por prueba en un 76.6% ($0.01972 vs. $0.08437) con cero tokens de imagen RGB.
es.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR — Aspectos Destacados de la Investigación y Resumen de Sistemas
es.finding1: Anclaje Simbólico 3D /tf sin Cámaras RGB: Desactivar la captura RGB (0 tokens de imagen) y alimentar poses 3D /tf a 50 Hz logró el ensamblaje del 100% (9/9 bloques) sin colisiones en las tres etapas.
es.finding2: Enrutamiento Híbrido Cerebro-Ejecutor (-76.6% Costo API): Ejecutar gemini-4-carbon una sola vez en el Turno 0 (thinking_budget=256) y delegar los Turnos 1–10 a gemini-3.5-flash-lite (thinking_budget=0) redujo el costo total a $0.01972 y la latencia inicial de 13.31 s a 4.17 s (-68.7%).
es.finding3: Intercalado Multi-Brazo Segmentado (10 vs. 13 Turnos): Mientras gemini-robotics-er-2-preview operó con barreras por oleada (13 turnos), gemini-4-carbon intercaló recolecciones externas con colocaciones centrales desde el Turno 3, terminando en 10 turnos y ahorrando 10,929 tokens.
es.videoHeader: Prueba de Simulación Sincronizada: Gemini Robotics-ER 2 (Izquierda) vs. Gemini 4 Carbon (Derecha)
es.ts1Title: Plano Espacial Turno 0 y Picks Paralelos
es.ts1Sub: Ambos planificadores leen poses 3D /tf y ejecutan 3 picks simultáneos (B1, B4, B7) en el Turno 1.
es.ts2Title: Divergencia en Turno 3: Barrera vs. Intercalado
es.ts2Sub: ER-2 coloca en serie mientras Carbon solapa pick(R1,B2) en la Mesa 1 con place(R2) en la torre central.
es.ts3Sub: Requiere 13 turnos (50,190 tokens, $0.07860) y termina sin enviar los brazos a casa (go_home).
es.ts4Title: Carbon Completa la Capa 9 + Homing (10 Turnos)
es.ts4Sub: Solapa go_home(R1, R2) durante las capas 8–9, completando los 9 bloques en 10 turnos (38,277 tokens).
